display_name.description: The source’s display name. Must be unique within the parent organization and follow naming rules.
display_name.rationale: The display name is used for identification and readability. It does not directly affect security but should be unique to avoid confusion.

organization.description: The organization in which the source exists. Format: organizations/[organization_id].
organization.rationale: Ensures the source is created in the correct organization. Misconfigured organization values can result in findings being logged under the wrong scope.

description.description: Optional description of the source (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: Provides human-readable context for admins. This field does not impact security.
